An opt-in CANNOT carry R2 or R3 - the compiler refuses it. So a RESTRICTED goal yields NO opt-in by construction, not by a runtime check this row writes.

OWNER RULING 2026-09-09 on the mapping arithmetic. The parent's DoD asked for set equality both directions between 3 AdvisoryRiskClass values and 4 POLICY_RISK_TIERS, which no total function can satisfy (a 3-set cannot surject onto a 4-set).
